focal_result: Normalización global de fibras desde cobertura; rango con h fijo sobre historias que publican valores de L[h]; dicotomía cardinal para cada subconjunto ambiente del portador R^L[h]; examen exacto de numerabilidad y cobertura al variar el parámetro. Ninguna candidata cumple aquí las tres condiciones globales de rango. La sección 9 reúne la composición completa en un límite de estados íntegros y prueba R8: recodificación biyectiva con restricciones y operaciones conjugadas. Section 10 proves R9-R13 on the inherited full enriched-history tree: native separated branches; a descending lexicographic chain; a perfect residual kernel still publishing the whole chart; the two strategy implications; and, under ambient Choice, a full-cardinality subset with neither strategy. None is promoted to universal CH.

tpk.action: N selects the least compatible state containing the already-published Val(x), after the HMT generator. lambda_h is first appearance of the rational cut in L_alpha[h] on D_h=Val^-1(R^L[h]). b(x) codes a produced complete history solely to test variable-parameter rank candidates; it is not claimed as a new HMT generation. The H0/H1 candidate has at most two levels and hence an uncountable value level. R8 recodes every complete finite state bijectively and transports each already-constructed typed operation by conjugation; the inverse-limit map is bijective. This coding is not promoted to an ordinal and does not replace the full TPK by its reduced publication. Section 10 proves R9-R13 on the inherited full enriched-history tree: native separated branches; a descending lexicographic chain; a perfect residual kernel still publishing the whole chart; the two strategy implications; and, under ambient Choice, a full-cardinality subset with neither strategy. None is promoted to universal CH.
